explanation: The Hero Ignitor 125 is a distinct model from all catalog candidates. None of the candidates match the Ignitor 125 in name, displacement, or known market/variant identities. The Hero Glamour X 125 and Xoom 125 are different models; Destini 110 and Destini Prime differ in displacement and model line; R 1200GS Adventure and RNT 150 Diesel Scooter Concept are unrelated motorcycles. HX 250R is a different brand/model entirely.
